newsitem.title: INDIA: India's OBC details operating profit.
newsitem.headline: India's OBC details operating profit.

text.p: India's Oriental Bank of Commerce (OBC) said on Friday that it expects operating profit to be about 3.0 billion rupees in 1996/97 (April-March).
The bank gave no comparative figure for 1995/96 in a statement released before a news conference.
The bank said that aggregate deposits exceeded 100 billion rupees in 1996/97 and it plans to take aggregate deposits to over 120 billion rupees in 1997/98.
The bank said advances would total some 65 billion rupees in 1997/98, up from about 50 billion in 1996/97.
